infoCards.title: Project Management
infoCards.description: Comprehensive solar project lifecycle management from site assessment to installation.

infoCards.title: System Monitoring
infoCards.description: Real-time monitoring and analytics for solar power systems.

faqData.question: How does the system handle project planning?
faqData.answer: Our system provides end-to-end project management including site surveys, design planning, installation scheduling and resource allocation with real-time progress tracking.

faqData.question: What monitoring capabilities are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive monitoring features with real-time performance tracking, energy production analytics and predictive maintenance alerts.

faqData.question: Can it manage multiple installation teams?
faqData.answer: Yes, the system supports multiple installation teams with resource scheduling, skill tracking and mobile app support for field operations.
